notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Big change - the 6 previous weapon skills are now merged into 3.  Having such specific weapon skills was causing too much upgrade lock-in, and most of the weapons in the game couldn't even be equipped on a single run.

Other changes:

[list]
    [*]Map vision stays around for longer
    [*]Slightly more morsels in the mid and late game
    [*]Ghost allies are not quite as tough with the Ghost whisperer ability
    [*]Improved balance of NG+++ player upgrade scaling
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
By popular request - you can now use morsels in combat.  Hold the B button (Q on keyboard) to consume your smallest morsel.  Morsels are still scarce, so use wisely!

Other changes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed accessories equipped to their existing slot causing them to be unequipped when reloaded
    [*]Fixed over-queuing of attacks when doing a sweeping attack or running stab
    [*]Fixed over-queuing of dodges when taking damage, particularly from ballistas
    [*]Marrow frenzy ability moved to Y button (hold to activate)
    [*]Greatsword slams are easier to land
    [*]Improved some of the end-game story scripting
    [*]Increased Resilience effectiveness

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
I've mostly been working on stability, but some gameplay tweaks too.  Unfortunately there are still a number of ongoing crashes out there.

Major Fixes
[list]
    [*]Fixed crash when changing weapons quickly after deflecting an arrow
    [*]Checkpoint files are backed up before saving or starting a NG+, to prevent lost progress in the case of corrupted save files
    [*]Fixed crash changing graphics setting
    [*]Fixed crash in UI
[/list]

Performance
[list]
    [*]Full res torch shadows disabled
[/list]

Gameplay
[list]
    [*]If you accidentally damage Anna too much, she will forgive you after killing you once 
    [*]Halberd does more damage to compensate for its higher requirements
    [*]Reduced swamp slow
    [*]Late game castle enemies made a bit easier, bosses a bit harder
    [*]Fixed Zarristar exploit with greatsword
    [*]Fixed Fuel Jar exploit
    [*]Fixed Fire Blade Oil effect not showing up after an exit
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.01 is live
notes.content:
The first update is live with some fixes and suggestions from the community.  Hopefully I didn't break anything =)

Gameplay
[list]
    [*]Crows now land occasionally, giving spear users an opportunity to hit them
    [*]Improved Bull damage accuracy, especially on charges
    [*]Depleted stamina warning shows if you failed a block, to make it clear what happened
[/list]

Input
[list]
    [*] Added keyboard shortcuts for menus: 1-4 (4 is the map shortcut)
    [*] Limited input bindings file, for keyboard only right now.  Located in Documents/DarkMaus/InputBindings.txt after you run once with this update.
[/list]

Bug fixes
[list]
    [*] Fixed loading of wrong save file with more than 10 save slots
    [*] Hopeful fix for crash that was happening randomly when deflecting an arrow
[/list]
